disposition_reason: Tables 3 and 4 print mean ± SD of 27 elements, including As, Cd, Hg and Pb, for 10 grain/flour groups and 10 bread/pasta groups bought in Austria.

study.design: Retail survey of grains, flours, bread and pasta (27 elements)
study.origin: Austria for grains/flours; breads AT, DE, FR; pasta AT, DE, IT (Table 1)
study.method: Freeze-drying (bread, pasta) then microwave-assisted HNO3 digestion (UltraCLAVE III, 250 C); ICP-MS (Agilent 8800, no-gas/He/H2/O2 modes)
study.qa: RM 8414 bovine muscle, NIST SRM 1568b rice flour, ALVA-PA15/3 wheat round-robin material in agreement (Table 2); internal standards; control standard every 10th sample; three blanks per run
